paragraphs: The X7 M60i sits at the top of the X7 range, powered by a 4.4-litre twin-turbo V8 producing 523hp. It was introduced with the 2022 G07 facelift, replacing the previous xDrive50i as the flagship petrol V8 option. The engine is the same S68-derived unit fitted to the contemporary X5 M60i and X6 M60i — a hot-vee twin-turbo design that's a separate and later development from the earlier N63/S63 family.
about.boldParagraph: The X7 M60i is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.
